THE ELECTRONIC AND POSTAL COMMUNICATIONS ACT, 
(CAP. 306) 
________ 

NOTICE 
_________ 

(Made under section 62(1)) 

THE ELECTRONIC AND POSTAL COMMUNICATIONS (PUBLICATION OF MARKETS 
AND DOMINANT OPERATORS IN TELECOMMUNICATION AND BROADCASTING 
SUBSECTORS) NOTICE, 2025 

Citation 

1.  This  Notice  may  be  cited  the  Electronic  and 
Postal  Communications  (Publication  of  Markets  and 
Mominant  Operators  in  Telecommunication  and  Broadca 
sting Subsectors) Notice, 2025. 

Interpretation 

2. The names set out in the Schedule to this Notice 
are markets and dominant operators in telecommunication 
and broadcasting subsectors.

ASSESSMENT OF COMPETITION IN TELECOMMUNICATION AND BROADCASTING 
SUBSECTORS IN TANZANIA 

LIST OF MARKETS AND DOMINANT OPERATORS 

The  Tanzania  Communication  Regulatory Authority  conducted  an  assessment  of  the  period  from 
January  to  December  2025  on  competition  in  telecommunication  and  broadcasting  sub-sectors  in 
Tanzania. Following the assessment, below are markets and dominant operators:
